task: 3-class classification: HC vs PD-NC vs PD-MCI (binary HC vs PD secondary)
protocol: Nested CV: outer stratified 5-fold (seed 42, same splits as v1); inner stratified 3-fold for all scaling, feature selection and hyperparameter search. Neural models: max 1000 epochs, early stopping (patience 50). Preprocessing v2: motion correction, Friston-24 regressors, FD scrubbing, high-variance confounds, Schaefer-100 and Schaefer-200.
note: Round 2 (nested cross-validation, motion correction, Friston-24 + FD scrubbing, high-variance confounds). Best 3-class model is Logistic regression at balanced accuracy 0.50 (accuracy 0.53, AUC 0.58) on Schaefer-100 parcels — atlas100 best balanced accuracy 0.50; atlas200 best balanced accuracy 0.44. Binary HC-vs-PD on this atlas: SVM (RBF) AUC 0.44, balanced accuracy 0.51 — lower than the first round's 0.74 AUC, because proper motion and noise cleaning removed signal that turned out to be noise, not brain activity (see the model card). The best binary model overall is XGBoost on Schaefer-200 (AUC 0.69). Two-stage (HC-vs-PD, then PD-NC-vs-PD-MCI) with logistic regression: combined balanced accuracy 0.40. Chance is 0.33 for 3-class. Full logs, confusion matrices and model card are in the GitHub repository. Research demo only — not a medical diagnosis. Round 3 (site harmonisation, ComBat, pooled n=264): best harmonised leave-one-source-out balanced accuracy 0.54 (svm_rbf, combat_loso) vs 0.51 unharmonised (xgboost). Chance is 0.50 for the binary task, so harmonisation did not lift the model above chance on a scanner it never saw — the pooled score was the scanners' fingerprints, not the disease. Harmonisation is fit on training folds only, so the leave-one-source-out numbers are the honest test of whether the model works on a scanner it never saw. Round 4D (neural nets on raw signal, no feature engineering): best pooled balanced accuracy 0.60 (d1_fc2d/pooled_5fold) and best leave-one-source-out balanced accuracy 0.57 (d1s_fc2d/loso). Chance is 0.50 for the binary task, so the unseen-scanner number is the honest test of whether the model works on a scanner it never saw. Round 4 (richer features — dynamic connectivity, graph measures, ALFF/fALFF, ReHo, structural; pooled n=395 across 7 sources: ds000245 45, ds001354 28, ds004392 58, ds005892 55, Neurocon 41, PPMI-195 128, Tao Wu 40; cognition staging n=78): the best honest leave-one-source-out binary balanced accuracy is 0.56 (ensemble, derived-fusion arm, n=209, 3 sources — no single-class fold). The headline 0.61 (SVM, raw-fusion arm) is inflated by the all-PD ds004392 fold, where balanced accuracy is just PD recall; without that fold it is 0.52. Pooled 5-fold best is 0.71 (SVM, derived fusion, n=209). ComBat still does not help (LOSO LR 0.59 as reported, 0.56 without the single-class fold). Cognition staging (NC/MCI/PDD, n=78): pooled LR 0.57, LOSO SVM 0.45 — but the LOSO SVM calls almost every subject MCI (recall 0.94 MCI, 0.00 NC, 0.00 PDD), so it stages nothing. Sex-stratified accuracy shows no meaningful gap (pooled LR: men 0.60, women 0.57). The ds006224 test-retest probe: connectivity is stable within a person (r 0.59) vs between people (r 0.42), but the best model's PD probabilities flip across sessions for 3 of 5 subjects. Chance is 0.50 binary / 0.33 3-class. 90% was not reached on any honest test — the cross-site disease signal in resting-state connectivity at this size is essentially absent. The ds004392 leave-one-source-out fold is all-PD, so its balanced accuracy is plain accuracy (PD recall) with no AUC — the reported LOSO means include it; the honest numbers exclude it. The ds006224 probe subjects also appear in training via the BrainNet PPMI-195 matrices, so probe agreement is a stability check, not independent validation. Round 4B (B-block time-series statistics: per-parcel std, skew, kurtosis, lag-1, Hurst, spectral entropy, plus per-subject brain states; same nested protocol as round 4): best pooled balanced accuracy 0.72 (stacking, b209_fusion_B/pooled_5fold) and best leave-one-source-out balanced accuracy 0.59 (balanced_bagging, b209_fusion_B/loso) after removing the all-PD ds004392 fold, where balanced accuracy is just PD recall (as reported it was 0.59). Chance is 0.50 for the binary task. The clean pipeline-mismatch test (b264_SG_unified vs the finisher's arm264_SG, same 264 subjects, same S+G blocks, only the ds005892 pipeline unified): pooled 0.633 vs 0.601, LOSO 0.517 vs 0.498 — unification did not recover accuracy on the honest test, so the drop is a site effect, not a pipeline effect. Round 4C (site-invariant transforms on the common blocks: rank, stable-rank, rank-Gaussian, age-residualised, z-score, lag-1 precision and partial correlation, plus a LOSO feature selector and a block stacker; fast screening only, the full run was skipped by the early-stop rule because fast LOSO was at chance): best pooled balanced accuracy 0.62 (svm_rbf, c_stable_common/pooled_5fold) and best leave-one-source-out balanced accuracy 0.53 (svm_rbf, c_lagprec/loso) after removing the all-PD ds004392 fold (as reported it was 0.56). Chance is 0.50. No transform lifted the unseen-scanner number above chance in any meaningful way.

round3_pooled.protocol: Nested CV: inner stratified 3-fold for all scaling, feature selection and hyperparameter search. Harmonisation is fit ONLY on each outer-train fold (combat/zscore); combat_trans is the labelled transductive exception (batch-only fit on all data, no labels). Pooled scheme: outer stratified 5-fold (seed 42). LOSO scheme: each fold holds out one whole source.

round4d.protocol: Nested CV: inner 15% split of each train fold used only for early stopping; architecture and epochs fixed before any fold ran. Pooled scheme: outer stratified 5-fold (seed 42). LOSO: each fold holds out one whole source; the ds004392 fold is all-PD, so it reports accuracy (= PD recall) and no AUC.
round4d.verdict: Round 4D (neural nets on raw signal, no feature engineering): best pooled balanced accuracy 0.60 (d1_fc2d/pooled_5fold) and best leave-one-source-out balanced accuracy 0.57 (d1s_fc2d/loso). cnn.killed: 2-fold mean balanced accuracy 0.464 < 0.53 — at chance, arm stopped
